en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a group of five uniformed men, likely World War I military personnel. Three men in flight or leather coats stand at left, one of them being examined or searched by an officer in the center, while another officer in a peaked cap stands to the right. The background shows a simple outdoor setting with a corrugated wall and a bench. Printed French text appears below the photograph.
